name: Akatsuki no Ganshou
source:
Main character is a teacher at a private girls' school. One day he and his students set off on excursion to Yokohama port and then by luxurious liner "Ingleb" to Hong Kong. However, they fall into a trap set by someone just before departure. Will they survive?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是私立女子学校的教师。一天，他与学生们外出旅行，先前往横滨港，再搭乘豪华客轮“英格莱布号”前往香港。然而，就在启程前，他们落入了某人设下的陷阱。众人能够活下来吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
